lighting.light_consistency_qa: Each subject must be legible in grayscale with plausible source, fill, rim, atmosphere; typography overlays deterministic; actual full-resolution generated-image QA required.

image_generation_policy.background: canon-safe cinematic scenes and motivated lighting
image_generation_policy.forbidden_in_generated_raster: No generated team names, record numbers, source percentages or readable copy
image_generation_policy.exact_overlay: Separate deterministic typography pass after rendering
image_generation_policy.must_preserve_identity: each canonical character crop SHA and Atlas structural plate

overlays.narrative_body: At the Waterfall Temple, three heads survey three different turns in the same unsettled distance. The single body must take one path. Red Leopards awaits first; then Mud, DK and ObiWan will each have a say in the Burgers race. Winning out would reach eight victories, still not a mathematical guarantee. Water strikes the old stone behind Snake, steady as the rules. The future depends on decisions not yet made.
overlays.math_scope_note: Still alive after a Week 11 loss; no berth clinched at Week 10.

overlays.narrative_body: Mud Dogs moves across raised swamp ground while water gathers in the tracks behind him. Two wins have left no spare step. Lose to Seven Deadly Chins and the race is mathematically over; win, then beat Snake, ObiWan and DK, and a narrow route could remain with outside help. The reeds do not part for him. He pushes through anyway. Hope here is a condition, not a promise.
overlays.math_scope_note: Must win all four. Outside help required. Week 11 loss = mathematical elimination.
